About Me

Building practical solutions with code and data

I'm a Computer Science student at Galgotias University with a focus on building scalable, data-driven applications. My work spans full-stack web development with JavaScript and TypeScript, data analysis with Python's scientific stack, and deploying production-ready tools on cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, and Vercel.

From analyzing job market trends to building crisis response platforms and AI-powered tools, I approach every project with an emphasis on real-world impact. I've competed in the NASA International Space Apps Challenge as a UI/UX designer and actively sharpen my algorithmic thinking through regular DSA practice on LeetCode.
